name: autoxpose
description: autoxpose 0.5.2 watches Docker labels and creates DNS records plus reverse-proxy hosts.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  autoxpose:
    image: mostafawahied/autoxpose:0.6.0@sha256:8b07a7c693c4270bb04adf4e68c16681de1336384ce70e86a507ab02ffeb09cd
    container_name: autoxpose
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      SERVER_IP: ""
      LAN_IP: ""
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/app/packages/backend/data
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
notes: Set SERVER_IP to the public address used for DNS A records and LAN_IP to the address the reverse proxy should target. Those are literal environment values in the install form. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables. Open http://localhost:4949 and add a DNS provider, then Nginx Proxy Manager or Caddy. The container reads the Docker socket read-only. The image entrypoint uses that socket file to match the Docker group before it drops privileges, so this listing does not replace the mount with a proxy.
